topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: It's strange, the twists life takes. Found out my online friend, Alex, lives in this city. We've chatted for months, shared so much. Now, the thought of meeting in person feels heavy, like trying to step into a pair of shoes that might not fit. The idea of crossing that line, from screen to street, is daunting. I keep thinking about how things might change, how the safety of our digital distance is suddenly gone. Maybe we'll find it's better to keep the barriers. I don't know. I just feel a pressing weight, like the sky is a bit too close today.
